title: Collections-automation market — attributed claim ledger
summary: All 24 claims from the sixteen vendored sources are attributed and confidence-rated: 11 verified facts, 13 inferences. One contradiction is flagged and left unresolved — two sources disagree about a competitor's pricing plans.

sections.heading: Contradiction: Slatebook pricing
sections.body: “Slatebook stated that list prices will remain unchanged through 2026.” (SRC-006, confidence high) directly conflicts with “A partner said Slatebook plans a twelve-percent enterprise price increase in November 2026.” (SRC-007, confidence low). Both sides stay in the ledger; the recommendation does not assume either is true.

sections.heading: Recommendation
sections.body: Medium confidence: do not let competitor list-price rumors set Ledgerly packaging. Keep the catalog at $49 / $99 / $249. Confirm the Slatebook price pair before any competitive-pricing claim in customer material.
